description: Insert the low len bits of v into x at bit pos (variable position and length)
notes: Real-world packing idiom (register and protocol field updates), written by us; the precondition 1 <= len <= 31 and pos + len <= 32 is stated with __builtin_assume. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: 13 IR instructions (the assume compares included), lowered with bzhi, shlx and andn. A masked-xor variant x ^ ((x ^ (v << pos)) & mask) was tried by hand: proven correct by Alive2 but slower in llvm-mca (274 vs 235 cycles per 100 iterations, godbolt llc and llvm-mca trunk, -mcpu=skylake). Whether clang's form is optimal is unknown.
